system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Your clans unique fighting style allows you to infuse chakra into your bones and layer the top layer of skin with a shell akin to the Chakra scalpel technique that can extend off of it like a flail, allowing your strike to pierce, slash and brutalize your opponent, known as the Medical Fist fighting stance.

As a Bonus action, you can enter your Medical Fist Taijutsu stance. While in this stance you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and can deal bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, your choice when you roll for damage.

Your melee attacks gain the Reach property if it didn’t already. If it did, increase the ranks of Reach by +1. This increases to +2 at 7th and +3 at 15th levels.

You can use either the Monstrous Burst or the Healers Touch benefit from Hanami clan Hijutsu you cast. You cannot gain both benefits as part of the same casting.

You gain a rank of mastery to Athletics based checks.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
